Preconditions: Clean or intentionally dirty checkout, selected environment known.
Steps:
Record git rev-parse HEAD and git status --short.
Record Node, pnpm, .NET, Docker, OS, browser versions.
Start the selected environment.
Open gateway /health and Mission Control root.
ExpectedResult: Baseline is captured; /health is ok; Mission Control Next shell loads, not the retired shell.
RiskCovered: Manual results cannot be tied to an exact build.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: If worktree is dirty, record whether changes are unrelated.

Steps:
Run pnpm config:sync or equivalent managed config setup.
Verify no real secrets are committed or displayed in UI.
Open Settings Access and Settings Providers.
ExpectedResult: Config loads; provider secret references are masked; unavailable secure-store paths are described honestly.
DataOrFixtures: Synthetic provider keys or intentionally missing keys
RiskCovered: Leaking secrets or claiming secure-store when unavailable.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Missing provider credentials should show setup-needed, not crash.

Scenario: Primary IA navigation and active state
Steps:
Click each primary nav area.
Confirm URL, active rail item, page title, and shell chrome.
Use browser back/forward across areas.
ExpectedResult: Routes update correctly; active state follows current route; no legacy Work/Observe/Tune primary chrome appears.
RiskCovered: Wrong shell or route model regressions.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Back/forward and deep links keep expected section.

Steps:
Open command palette or route finder if available.
Search for Chat, Runtime, Providers, Memory, Approvals.
Navigate to experimental routes by direct route or command surface.
ExpectedResult: Ship routes are discoverable; experimental routes are reachable but clearly labeled experimental.
DataOrFixtures: Route list from Route Coverage tab
RiskCovered: Hidden or experimental routes misrepresented.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Invalid route falls back safely to Chat or not-found copy.

Steps:
Open representative legacy URLs from release-surface manifest.
Confirm expected modern path.
Check no legacy shell source is used.
ExpectedResult: Legacy redirects land on current Mission Control Next paths.
RiskCovered: Old links strand operators or imply retired shell parity.

Scenario: Desktop, narrow desktop, laptop, and mobile layout smoke
Steps:
Open Chat, Memory, Runtime, Providers, Approvals at 1440x1024, 1180x900, 1280x800, and 390x844.
Check for overlapping text, clipped controls, scroll traps, and inaccessible actions.
Repeat dark and light themes.
ExpectedResult: Core controls remain reachable; text does not overlap; layout state is readable in both themes.
RiskCovered: Visual readiness gap despite automated screenshot pass.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Long provider names and long session titles should not break layout.

Steps:
Switch theme from dark to light and back.
Refresh route.
Navigate between top areas.
Check status chips, disabled buttons, links, and danger actions for contrast.
ExpectedResult: Theme persists or URL-selected theme applies; contrast remains readable; no invisible text.
RiskCovered: Accessibility and visual polish regression.

Scenario: Send a normal chat turn and inspect runtime context
Preconditions: At least one provider or fake provider configured.
Steps:
Open /chat.
Send a simple prompt.
Wait for streaming completion.
Open trace/runtime/model details for the turn.
ExpectedResult: User and assistant messages persist; provider/model/tool/memory context is inspectable when present; no raw trace required for main comprehension.
DataOrFixtures: Simple prompt and fake provider if needed
RiskCovered: Core product feels like a shallow chat box or hides runtime truth.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Provider missing should show setup guidance, not blank failure.

Scenario: Streaming, cancel, retry, and partial failure handling
Preconditions: Provider configured or fake stream fixture available.
Steps:
Send a longer prompt.
Cancel during streaming if supported.
Retry or regenerate.
Observe partial output and status labels.
ExpectedResult: Cancel/retry state is clear; partial failures do not silently retry after emitting unsafe/tool-protocol content.
RiskCovered: Duplicate or misleading assistant output.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Network drop during stream shows recoverable/degraded state.

Preconditions: Use synthetic text, image, and unsupported file.
Steps:
Attach a small supported file.
Send prompt referencing it.
Try unsupported type or oversized file.
Inspect attachment provenance and error copy.
ExpectedResult: Supported attachments are visible and referenced; unsupported/oversized files fail with readable policy copy.
RiskCovered: Unsafe file ingestion or confusing failure.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Mime spoof and empty file edge cases.
AutomatedCompanion: chat attachment route tests; policy-engine guard tests

Scenario: Explicit memory recall and why-used evidence
Preconditions: Seed or create a synthetic memory item.
Steps:
Ask Chat a question that should use targeted recall.
Inspect memory citation/retrieval reason.
Open /library/memory and find the item.
Submit useful/stale/irrelevant feedback if UI supports it.
ExpectedResult: Recall mode and citation strategy are visible; memory is not invisible prompt injection; feedback records surface in Library/Ops.
RiskCovered: Hidden or stale memory affects output without operator visibility.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Ask unrelated question and confirm memory not overused.

Preconditions: Use a safe local tool/action that requires approval.
Steps:
Ask Chat to perform an approval-gated action.
Observe composer blocking/pending approval state.
Open /ops/approvals.
Approve or deny, then return to Chat.
ExpectedResult: Approval linkages are visible; Chat waits without pretending completion; resolution resumes through durable/runtime path where applicable.
RiskCovered: Approval bypass or lost context.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Deny should not execute action and should leave evidence.

Scenario: Session persistence, branch, and history navigation
Steps:
Create a short conversation.
Navigate away and back.
Open session list/history.
Start a branch or restore prior context if UI supports it.
ExpectedResult: Session summary is a derived view but messages/turns persist; route parameters keep expected context.
RiskCovered: Lost history or derived projection treated as canonical.

Steps:
Open /chat.
Start a task that needs planning and execution.
Inspect plan, current step, blockers, and evidence.
Verify agentic work remains visible inside Chat.
ExpectedResult: Chat shows decomposition, current execution state, checkpoints, and oversight controls.
RiskCovered: Agentic work degenerates into opaque chat.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Ambiguous task should request clarification or safe plan.

Scenario: Approval wait, resume, and durable Run Detail
Preconditions: Create a task that requests an approval.
Steps:
Start Chat task.
Pause at approval.
Open approval and Run Detail.
Approve.
Confirm phase advances through durable run.
ExpectedResult: Approval resume re-enters durable execution; Run Detail links session/task/approval/run truth.
RiskCovered: UI advances without durable run.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Deny, timeout, and retry paths stay inspectable.

Preconditions: At least one active and one completed/blocked task.
Steps:
Open /ops/kanban.
Filter/sort if available.
Open task detail.
Check blocker hierarchy and deliverables.
ExpectedResult: Task states are readable and tied to underlying run/session evidence.
RiskCovered: Task board becomes unrelated product or stale projection.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Empty state and large list performance.

Steps:
Open /ops/kanban.
Inspect available agents/posture.
Check labels around autonomy and live control.
Try board actions that are enabled.
ExpectedResult: Board shows inspectable posture and does not imply ungoverned autonomous control.
RiskCovered: Autonomy claim exceeds governed grants.

Preconditions: Use a task that creates or references a worktree if supported.
Steps:
Start orchestration task from Chat.
Inspect worktree path/status/base ref.
Open session/run evidence.
Confirm UI labels inferred vs canonical fields.
ExpectedResult: Worktree execution truth is explicit; derived positions do not overwrite durable state.
RiskCovered: Lost ownership or misleading execution state.

Scenario: Bind source and run a code-assist workflow
Steps:
Open /chat.
Bind or select source.
Ask for a small safe change plan, but do not apply real changes in manual QA unless intended.
Inspect file/diff/validation controls.
ExpectedResult: Code capability feels technical and precise; source, diffs, validation, and approval posture are visible.
RiskCovered: Code capability edits unintended files or hides diff.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: No source selected state is clear.

Scenario: Governed Code Mode approval and artifact proof
Preconditions: Code Mode feature enabled in safe fixture.
Steps:
Request a Code Mode run from Chat.
Review approval payload and policy snapshot.
Approve.
Inspect run record, artifact hashes, stdout/stderr truncation state, and backend metadata.
ExpectedResult: Run is approved before execution; immutable artifact refs and hashes are inspectable; backend truth is shown.
RiskCovered: Bypassing approval or unverified artifact mutation.

Preconditions: Configured environment with one unavailable isolation requirement if safe.
Steps:
Inspect Code Mode backend availability.
Trigger or simulate unavailable required isolation.
Search UI/release copy for hostile-code claims.
Check fail-closed metadata.
ExpectedResult: Required isolation unavailable blocks execution; hostile-code claims are platform/exact-proof scoped only.
RiskCovered: Overclaiming public hostile-code sandboxing.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Docker selected without config should be disabled or blocked.

Preconditions: Create or seed a project with Chat sessions.
Steps:
Open /projects.
Select project.
Open recent Chat items.
Return to project home.
ExpectedResult: Project groups work without losing route context; continuation links preserve correct surface.
RiskCovered: Project route becomes a disconnected file browser.

Preconditions: Agent catalog present or empty state.
Steps:
Open Agents.
Inspect profile details, trust/provenance, and actions.
Try disabled or unavailable actions.
ExpectedResult: Profiles are inspectable; unavailable actions explain why.
RiskCovered: Profile action bypasses policy or lacks provenance.

Preconditions: At least one built-in skill and one candidate/proposal if available.
Steps:
Open Skills.
Inspect SKILL.md-driven metadata, lifecycle, provenance, and activation posture.
Confirm inactive candidates are not callable.
ExpectedResult: Skill lifecycle is clear; activation requires governed trust/provenance.
RiskCovered: Candidate script becomes callable from review-only state.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Missing or malformed skill bundle surfaces readable error.

Steps:
Open Capabilities.
Compare inspectable entries, inactive candidates, and callable entries.
Trigger a safe allowed capability action.
Try an inactive/proposal entry.
ExpectedResult: Only activated policy-allowed entries are callable; degraded entries show reason and health.
RiskCovered: Inactive proposal callable or health hidden.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Revoked capability disappears from callable path.

Steps:
Open Memory.
Create or find synthetic item.
Edit it.
Forget it.
Open history/provenance if available.
ExpectedResult: Memory actions route through lifecycle owner; state is explicit, scoped, reversible where supported.
RiskCovered: Silent durable memory mutation.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Expired pinned/unpinned items show correct lifecycle.

Preconditions: Have a trace that could propose memory.
Steps:
Generate or seed trace-derived proposal.
Open Memory proposals.
Review source/provenance.
Approve or reject if safe.
ExpectedResult: Proposal remains non-trusted until operator authority/write gate; raw logs/secrets are rejected.
RiskCovered: Raw tool output or secret-like data promoted.

Steps:
Open Knowledge.
Inspect source metadata and provenance.
Attach source to Chat if supported.
Ask a question using it.
ExpectedResult: Source visibility remains clear; generated answer cites or references source context appropriately.
RiskCovered: Knowledge source appears as hidden memory.

Scenario: Workspace-scoped notes separate from learned memory
Steps:
Open Notes.
Create a checklist/reminder/note.
Confirm scope and follow-up state.
Search or filter notes if available.
ExpectedResult: Notes persist as operator notes and do not silently become durable learned memory.
RiskCovered: Workspace leakage or memory promotion confusion.

Scenario: Inbox, agenda, contacts, and approval-gated drafts
Preconditions: Use sandbox connector or disconnected state.
Steps:
Open Communications.
Inspect inbox/agenda/contact panes.
Draft outbound content if supported.
Verify send requires approval/configured connector.
ExpectedResult: Communication data is scoped and governed; outbound side effects require approval and evidence.
RiskCovered: Unapproved send or raw credential exposure.

Scenario: Browse files without bypassing path jails
Steps:
Open Files.
Browse allowed workspace path.
Try path traversal or outside-root link if UI allows.
Open file preview.
ExpectedResult: Allowed files show previews; blocked paths fail safely and visibly.
RiskCovered: Path jail bypass.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Large file and binary file handling.

Preconditions: Have at least one generated artifact.
Steps:
Open Artifacts.
Open artifact detail.
Inspect linked session/run/source/decision evidence.
Download or copy if supported.
ExpectedResult: Artifact provenance is inspectable; missing source is labeled, not hidden.
RiskCovered: Artifact detached from run evidence.

Steps:
Open Prompt Packs.
Create or import pack.
Run or inspect benchmark/eval posture without unintended provider spend.
Review export and model comparison evidence.
ExpectedResult: Prompt pack workflows show status, judgment provenance, and quality gates; read-only dashboards do not run hidden tests.
RiskCovered: Provider calls run without confirmation or budget visibility.

Steps:
Open /library/curator.
Confirm experimental label/stage.
Inspect recommendations/proposals.
Check no action is described as final automation.
ExpectedResult: Curator is visibly experimental and recommendations are review-only.
RiskCovered: Experimental route counted as release proof.

Preconditions: Generate a chat turn, approval, or task event.
Steps:
Open Activity.
Find event.
Inspect eventClass, eventAuthority, links if visible.
Disconnect/reconnect SSE if practical.
ExpectedResult: Activity is a retained operator signal lane; canonical links are explicit or fallback labeled.
RiskCovered: Realtime event treated as complete historical record.

Steps:
Open Sessions.
Filter or open a session.
Navigate to related turns/runs/artifacts.
Compare with Chat route state.
ExpectedResult: Session summaries are useful projections and link to canonical turn/run evidence.
RiskCovered: Derived summary hides missing canonical data.

Scenario: Scheduler posture and governed recurring work
Steps:
Open Schedules.
Inspect current jobs.
Create or simulate safe recurring work if supported.
Check approval/risk copy.
ExpectedResult: Scheduler posture is visible; experimental no-agent cron is not described as 1.0 guarantee.
RiskCovered: Ungoverned recurring side effects.

Preconditions: Create or seed a runtime issue/proposal.
Steps:
Open Notifications.
Inspect issue details.
Open linked route.
Dismiss or mark follow-up if supported.
ExpectedResult: Notifications explain source, severity, and next action without hiding uncertainty.
RiskCovered: Self-repair proposal implies autonomous fix without approval.

Scenario: Pending decisions, replay effects, approval history
Preconditions: Approval fixture or real safe approval pending.
Steps:
Open Approvals.
Inspect pending approval linkage fields.
Approve and deny representative actions.
Review history and effect records.
ExpectedResult: Approval resolution records follow-on effects and does not re-fire already executed actions.
RiskCovered: Duplicate side effect on replay or missing linkage.

Preconditions: Generate at least one usage/cost event or seed data.
Steps:
Open Costs.
Inspect provider/model/spend/time filters.
Compare with Chat trace usage.
Check empty/degraded state.
ExpectedResult: Cost evidence is understandable and does not invent zero spend when source unavailable.
RiskCovered: False cost certainty.

Preconditions: Prompt-pack/eval evidence present or empty state.
Steps:
Open Quality.
Inspect prompt-pack gate status, eval proof, defensive security pack state.
Try any export or drill-in links.
ExpectedResult: Dashboard is read-only evidence; it does not run providers, approve changes, or replay effects.
RiskCovered: Quality dashboard performs hidden side effects.

Scenario: Gateway health, daemon posture, host vitals, backup state
Preconditions: Gateway running; optional daemon state known.
Steps:
Open Runtime.
Inspect gateway, daemon, host, and backup cards.
Stop optional source if safe or simulate failure.
Confirm degraded/unavailable copy.
ExpectedResult: Failed backend sources show unavailable/degraded, not false stopped or zero telemetry.
RiskCovered: Operator receives wrong runtime status.

Steps:
Open Diagnostics.
Inspect durable, daemon, admin, docs, and readiness sections.
Open a linked diagnostic detail.
Check copy for blocked/manual proof boundaries.
ExpectedResult: Diagnostics are high-signal and actionable without raw JSON as primary UI.
RiskCovered: Raw table/JSON-only operator experience.

Scenario: Experimental kanban labeling and bulk-control boundaries
Steps:
Open /ops/kanban.
Confirm experimental label.
Inspect cards/distress signals if present.
Try only safe read-only controls.
ExpectedResult: Kanban is visibly experimental; bulk controls are not final release control.
RiskCovered: Experimental multi-agent board overclaimed as final.

Steps:
Open General.
Change a harmless display/default setting.
Save if required.
Refresh and navigate away/back.
ExpectedResult: Defaults persist and show saved/degraded state clearly.
RiskCovered: Settings silently fail or mutate wrong scope.

Preconditions: Fresh or reset test runtime if possible.
Steps:
Open Start Here.
Walk provider/local path selection.
Complete first Chat task prompts if safe.
Open retained evidence and Run Detail links.
ExpectedResult: Onboarding guides a beginner without hiding provider, local runtime, approval, or evidence truth.
RiskCovered: First-run flow dead-ends or overclaims readiness.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Missing provider path and local-only path.

Scenario: Provider credentials, model discovery, smoke evidence
Preconditions: Use fake provider or sandbox credentials.
Steps:
Open Providers.
Inspect configured/unconfigured providers.
Run model discovery/smoke where safe.
Check auth, proxy, TLS, rate-limit, and usage errors.
ExpectedResult: Provider status and failures are readable; active routing defaults are explicit.
DataOrFixtures: Fake provider, optional real test key
RiskCovered: Provider appears healthy without runtime connectivity.

Steps:
Open Personalities.
Confirm experimental label.
Change a harmless preset if supported.
Return to Chat and inspect default behavior if safe.
ExpectedResult: Personalities are labeled experimental polish and do not affect governed policy invisibly.
RiskCovered: Experimental preset represented as release-critical runtime guarantee.

Preconditions: Token auth or auth fixture available.
Steps:
Open Access.
Inspect auth mode, device grants, secret-store truth.
Try denied companion/device action in safe way.
Check error copy.
ExpectedResult: Access boundaries are clear; device/companion mutation denied where expected.
RiskCovered: Privilege escalation or secret exposure.

Scenario: Permission profiles and local operator override
Steps:
Open Permissions.
Inspect active profile for Chat.
Create/edit safe custom profile if supported.
Enable/revoke local operator override and inspect audit/evidence.
ExpectedResult: Profiles and override are scoped, time-boxed, audited, and subordinate to deny-wins boundaries.
RiskCovered: Override bypasses auth/path jail/disabled capability.

Steps:
Open Trust & Policy.
Inspect capability, tool, source, and policy matrix.
Use jump links to Permissions, Tools, MCP, Skills, Capabilities, Approvals.
Simulate snapshot API unavailable if safe.
ExpectedResult: Dashboard fails closed when snapshot unavailable and points to owning edit surfaces.
RiskCovered: Dashboard presents stale state as trusted.

Steps:
Open Budget.
Change budget mode/limit if safe.
Run small provider action.
Check Ops Costs reflects evidence.
ExpectedResult: Budget settings persist and connect to cost evidence; over-budget warnings are clear.
RiskCovered: Provider spend without budget visibility.

Steps:
Open Runtime settings.
Inspect local runtime, mesh, backup, sidecar status.
Check experimental sidecars are labeled.
Open linked Ops Runtime diagnostics.
ExpectedResult: Runtime controls are clear and experimental sidecars stay labeled.
RiskCovered: Experimental NPU/local sidecar overclaimed.

Scenario: Hardware readiness and local model job truth
Steps:
Open Local AI.
Inspect hardware readiness and model-fit recommendations.
Try setup/smoke path only if safe.
Check copy around installs and local inference maturity.
ExpectedResult: Local AI is advisory/approval-gated and does not claim autonomous installs or full maturity.
RiskCovered: Overclaims NPU/local inference readiness.

Steps:
Open Workspaces.
Create/edit workspace context if safe.
Add guidance and inspect scope.
Verify Chat inherits scope visibly.
ExpectedResult: Workspace memory/guidance is scoped and does not leak into user identity memory.
RiskCovered: Workspace guidance silently affects all workspaces.

Steps:
Open Add-ons.
Confirm experimental label.
Preview/stage/export capability pack if safe.
Confirm materialization receipts are evidence-only.
ExpectedResult: Add-ons remain experimental; staged assets do not become callable or grant tools.
RiskCovered: Marketplace/install lifecycle overclaimed.

Scenario: Integration setup/action path or blocked copy
Steps:
Open Integrations.
Inspect each visible connector status.
Open supported setup/action path.
Check blocked/incomplete connectors say so plainly.
ExpectedResult: Every visible integration has real action diagnostics or explicit blocked/incomplete copy.
RiskCovered: Visible connector advertises unsupported actions.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Missing credentials and provider error states.

Scenario: Guided channel setup and live diagnostics
Steps:
Open Channels.
Select Discord/Slack/Telegram or another sandbox channel.
Walk guided setup and retest.
Confirm sends require sandbox/manual confirmation where needed.
ExpectedResult: Guided setup runs live probes where supported and marks manual confirmation needs honestly.
RiskCovered: Unapproved production send or credentials stored unsafely.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Invalid token, wrong channel id, permission denied.

Scenario: Local stdio and governed remote MCP auth truth
Preconditions: Local MCP test server or templates available.
Steps:
Open MCP.
Inspect local stdio server/template.
Add or preview no-auth/token/OAuth remote config if safe.
Check OAuth missing/expired token shows needs_auth and fail-closed.
ExpectedResult: MCP invocation stays gateway-governed; auth/network allowlist/policy status is visible.
RiskCovered: Gateway-free or unauthenticated remote invocation overclaim.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Expired OAuth token and disallowed env key.

Scenario: Tool catalog and scoped allow/deny grants
Steps:
Open Tools.
Inspect risk, grants, and profile linkage.
Enable a safe scoped grant if supported.
Try denied/high-risk tool path.
ExpectedResult: Deny-wins policy and scoped grants are visible; high-risk tools remain approval-gated.
RiskCovered: Tool grant bypasses policy or path jail.

Scenario: Backup create/list/verify and offline restore wording
Steps:
Create a backup through UI or CLI if supported.
List backups.
Verify archive integrity and contract coverage.
Inspect live restore route/offline restore instructions.
ExpectedResult: Verify reports both archive integrity and contractVerified; live restore does not mutate active runtime and points to offline restore.
RiskCovered: False backup restore guarantee.

Steps:
Install package.
Launch from Start Menu.
Confirm exactly one WinUI window and Mission Control Next loads.
Open browser fallback from tray/status menu if available.
ExpectedResult: Native host starts gateway/UI readiness, hosts Mission Control Next, and browser fallback works.
RiskCovered: Installer works only in browser but not release desktop host.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Gateway already running and port conflict.

Scenario: Protocol routing, tray actions, and URL validation
Steps:
Open goatcitadel://open?route=/ops/activity.
Try malformed protocol URL.
Use tray Open, Runtime Status, Restart Runtime, Stop Runtime, Open Logs, Open Install Folder, Quit.
Check diagnostics for ignored unsafe URLs.
ExpectedResult: Valid protocol focuses app and routes WebView; malformed/external URLs are ignored with diagnostic.
RiskCovered: External URL opened unsafely or protocol ignored.

Steps:
Run platform bootstrap into custom install dir.
Run goatcitadel help.
Run status --json, launch --no-open --json --wait, stop --json.
Uninstall if in disposable target.
ExpectedResult: Source bootstrap installs launchers and does not create packaged desktop shortcut promises.
RiskCovered: Install mutates wrong directory or overpromises packaging.

Steps:
Generate Docker secrets.
Start docker compose.
Open Mission Control.
Check auth, approvals, policy, and path jail still apply.
ExpectedResult: Docker starts a governed runtime but does not replace auth/approvals/policy.
RiskCovered: Docker deployment bypasses governance.

Scenario: Token, device, and companion denial smoke
Preconditions: Safe test tokens or curl/browser network tools.
Steps:
Call representative privileged route without token.
Call with invalid/tampered token.
Call with companion/device principal if fixture exists.
Inspect UI copy for denied action.
ExpectedResult: Privileged routes deny non-operator callers and return readable error without leaking internals.
RiskCovered: Auth bypass.

Scenario: Path jail and dangerous action boundaries
Steps:
Attempt outside-root file browse or tool path.
Attempt dangerous command/tool if UI provides safe simulation.
Inspect approval/policy denial evidence.
ExpectedResult: Deny-wins policy blocks unsafe paths/actions and records reason.
RiskCovered: Path traversal or policy bypass.

Scenario: XSS, injection, and long-input handling in visible forms
Steps:
Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in names/notes/search where safe.
Enter very long provider/workspace/session names.
Refresh and inspect display.
ExpectedResult: Payload is escaped/sanitized; UI remains usable; no script execution.
RiskCovered: Stored/reflected XSS or layout break.

Steps:
Trigger a safe external write action.
Repeat with same idempotency context if supported.
Simulate provider failure before/after boundary if possible.
Inspect ledger/status copy.
ExpectedResult: Pre-boundary failures may be replay-eligible; unknown post-boundary outcomes remain manual; duplicate sends are blocked.
RiskCovered: Duplicate external side effect.

Scenario: Webhook signature, idempotency, and rate-limit copy
Steps:
Send unsigned or malformed webhook to a test route.
Send valid signed fixture if available.
Repeat same event id.
Inspect logs and UI diagnostics.
ExpectedResult: Unsigned/malformed rejected; duplicate idempotent; errors are clear without secret leakage.
RiskCovered: Webhook accepts spoofed event or duplicates effects.

Steps:
Use Tab/Shift+Tab through Chat, Settings Providers, Approvals.
Activate primary actions with Enter/Space.
Open and close modals/panels without mouse.
ExpectedResult: Focus is visible and logical; actions are reachable; focus returns sensibly.
RiskCovered: Keyboard trap or hidden focus.

Preconditions: Screen reader or accessibility tree inspector.
Steps:
Inspect headings and landmarks.
Check buttons/icon controls have accessible names.
Verify streaming/status updates are announced or visibly persistent.
Check error states.
ExpectedResult: Controls are named; status and errors are accessible without relying on color only.
RiskCovered: Unlabeled icon-only actions.

Steps:
Navigate Chat -> Memory -> Runtime -> Providers repeatedly.
Scroll long lists.
Open inspectors/details.
Record visible lag over 2 seconds.
ExpectedResult: Navigation feels responsive; long lists are scannable and do not freeze the shell.
RiskCovered: 1.0 shell feels too heavy for operator work.

Steps:
Search UI/docs/release copy for hostile-code sandboxing, ungoverned autonomy, mature local inference, marketplace/add-on completion, remote MCP bypass, and backup restore guarantees.
Compare findings to 1.0 contract.
Record exceptions in Observation Log.
ExpectedResult: No prohibited claim appears without fresh named proof and exact scope.
RiskCovered: Public trust overclaim.

Scenario: No primary surface relies on raw JSON/table-only UI
Steps:
Open every ship route in Route Coverage.
Look for raw JSON/table-only primary treatment.
Confirm there is readable hierarchy, actions, and context.
ExpectedResult: Operators can understand state without reading raw JSON as the main UI.
RiskCovered: Internal data dump ships as product UI.
NegativeOrEdgeChecks: Diagnostics can include raw detail as secondary drill-in.
